method: Held-out random sample of 30 real-money pairs, excluding the first sample (scripts/sample.mjs --seed 20260926 --exclude random-sample.json, data snapshot 2026-09-25T15:55:49Z). Labeled against the rule texts before looking at any AI verdict for these pairs, with the same definitions as random-labels.json: equivalent — the rules match in substance; caveats — they match except for rare edge cases or settlement timing; different — there is a plausible scenario in which the markets settle differently. Used to check judge v2, which was tuned on the first sample.
reviewer: Claude (AI assistant), not independently re-checked by a human
